text: I had a consultation for orthodontics with a male doctor. He was impolite and seemed dismissive. I was in the room for less than two minutes and didn't get anything done. He only wanted to look at the X-rays. At least a little advice would have been appreciated. I regret wasting my money. I explained the problems I wanted treated, but he still said it was just a minor issue, in a tone like he didn't want to proceed. Well, as a patient, I have the right to say that! It was completely different from the female doctor who gave excellent advice.
I just got my teeth whitened today. The dentist and assistant were very attentive and gave excellent advice.
